verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fivetran syncs databases with automatic incremental syncs, captures deletes, and offers Soft Delete and History sync modes, which covers the update/delete-capture part of the story. Nothing in the pack names the log-based mechanism (binlog, WAL, logical replication) or addresses source load, so the core CDC claim is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) documentation, database-specific connector docs (Postgres/MySQL replication setup), evidence of low source impact, independent hands-on corroboration of CDC behavior.
